```{r}
# Import data
library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)
library(caret)
library(earth)      
library(MASS)       
library(pROC)
library(vip)
library(pdp)
library(car)

auto <- read.csv("auto.csv")

auto$mpg_cat <- as.factor(auto$mpg_cat)
auto$origin <- as.factor(auto$origin)
```

```{r}
# train test split
set.seed(1)
data_split <- initial_split(auto, prop = 0.7, strata = mpg_cat)
training_data <- training(data_split)
testing_data  <- testing(data_split)
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
# cross validation
ctrl <- trainControl(
  method = "cv",
  number = 10,
  summaryFunction = twoClassSummary,
  classProbs = TRUE
)
```

# Problem a
```{r}
set.seed(1)
glm.fit <- glm(mpg_cat ~ .,
               data = training_data,
               family = binomial(link = "logit"))
summary(glm.fit)
vif(glm.fit)
```
Predictors with a large p-value such as cylinders, displacement, horsepower, acceleration might be redundant. They are not statistically significant after controlling for the others, since they have a p-value greater than 0.05, possibly due to multicollinearity or overlapping information.

```{r}
# train logistic regression model with CV
set.seed(1)
model.glm <- train(x = training_data[, names(training_data) != "mpg_cat"],
y = training_data$mpg_cat,
method = "glm",
metric = "ROC",
trControl = ctrl)
```

# Problem b
```{r}
# train MARS
set.seed(1)
model.mars <- train(
  x = training_data[, names(training_data) != "mpg_cat"],
  y = training_data$mpg_cat,
  method = "earth",
  tuneGrid = expand.grid(
    degree = 1:2,
    nprune = 2:20
  ),
  metric = "ROC",
  trControl = ctrl
)
plot(model.mars)
```
```{r}
set.seed(1)
# compare models using resampling
res <- resamples(list(GLM = model.glm,
                      MARS = model.mars))
summary(res)
# boxplot of ROC performance for the 2 models
bwplot(res, metric = "ROC")
```

# Problem c
```{r}
set.seed(1)
lda.fit <- lda(mpg_cat ~ ., data = training_data)
# plot discriminant
plot(lda.fit)
# show coefficients
lda.fit$scaling
```
```{r}
# Cross validation LDA
set.seed(1)
model.lda <- train(mpg_cat ~ ., 
                   data = training_data, 
                   method = "lda", 
                   metric = "ROC", 
                   trControl = ctrl)
```

# Problem d
```{r}
set.seed(1)
# compare models using resampling
res <- resamples(list(GLM = model.glm,
                      LDA = model.lda,
                      MARS = model.mars))
summary(res)
# boxplot of ROC performance for the 3 models
bwplot(res, metric = "ROC")
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
# predictions on test data for each model
glm.pred  <- predict(model.glm,  newdata = testing_data, type = "prob")[,2]
mars.pred <- predict(model.mars, newdata = testing_data, type = "prob")[,2]
lda.pred  <- predict(model.lda,  newdata = testing_data, type = "prob")[,2]


roc.glm  <- roc(testing_data$mpg_cat, glm.pred)
roc.mars <- roc(testing_data$mpg_cat, mars.pred)
roc.lda  <- roc(testing_data$mpg_cat, lda.pred)

auc <- c(roc.glm$auc[1], roc.lda$auc[1], roc.mars$auc[1])
```

```{r}
set.seed(1)
# plot ROC curves for all models
modelNames <- c("glm","lda","mars")
ggroc(list(roc.glm, roc.lda, roc.mars), legacy.axes = TRUE) +
scale_color_discrete(labels = paste0(modelNames, " (", round(auc,3),")"),
name = "Models (AUC)") +
geom_abline(intercept = 0, slope = 1, color = "grey")
```

# Problem e
```{r}
final.prob <- mars.pred

final.pred <- rep(levels(training_data$mpg_cat)[1], length(final.prob))
final.pred[final.prob > 0.5] <- levels(training_data$mpg_cat)[2]

final.pred <- as.factor(final.pred)

confusionMatrix(
  data = final.pred,
  reference = testing_data$mpg_cat,
  positive = levels(training_data$mpg_cat)[2]
)
```
